question: What is the action considered in the U(1) gauge x U(1) global model?

The action considered in the $U(1)_{\text{gauge}} \times U(1)_{\text{global}}$ model is given by:

$$S = - \left[ \beta_g \right]^2 \left[ H \right]_{\phi} \left[ * \right]_1 \left( \left[ x \right] \left[ \right] \left[ U \right]_{\mu} \left[ \right] \left[ x \right] \left[ \right] \left[ \phi \right]_1 \left[ 1 \right] \left( \left[ x \right] \left[ + \right] \left[ \mu \right] \left[ \hat{} \right] \right) - \beta_H \right.$$

$$\left. \left[ x, \mu \right] \right] \left( U_{\mu\nu} (x) + \text{c.c.} \right) - \left[ x, \mu \right] \left\langle \nu \right\rangle \right. \tag{2.1}$$

Alternatively, it can be expressed as:

$$S = \beta_H \left[ - \left( \cos(\Delta_{\mu}\theta_1(x) + A_{\mu}(x)) + \cos(\Delta_{\mu}\theta_2(x) + A_{\mu}(x)) \right) \right] - \left\langle x, \mu \right\rangle \cos(F_{\mu\nu}(x)) \cdot \tag{2.2}$$

In this action, $\phi_1(x) = \exp[i\theta_1(x)]$ and $\phi_2(x) = \exp[i\theta_2(x)]$ are $U(1)$-valued charged scalar fields representing the phase component of the Higgs fields, and $\beta_H$ is the hopping parameter. The term $U_{\mu}(x) = \exp[iA_{\mu}(x)]$ is the $U(1)$ link variable.
